name: MonarchPresenceDot
title: PresenceDot
summary: A small dot for a person's presence: online, away, busy, do not disturb or offline, read by TalkBack as text.
whenToUse: Beside a name or on an avatar, to show whether a person can be reached.
whenNotToUse: For the status of a thing rather than a person, such as a service or a job, use MonarchStatusDot or MonarchBadge.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPresenceDot(status: MonarchPresenceStatus, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchPresenceDotSize = MonarchPresenceDotSize.Md, customStatus: String? = null, overlay: Boolean = false, decorative: Boolean = false, statusLabel: String? = null)
enum class MonarchPresenceStatus { Online, Away, Busy, DoNotDisturb, Offline }
enum class MonarchPresenceDotSize { Sm, Md, Lg }

options.name: size
options.description: Sm 8dp, Md 10dp or Lg 12dp at the default font size.

options.name: customStatus
options.description: The person's own status message, added to the text TalkBack reads. Blank text is ignored.

options.name: overlay
options.description: Draws a 2dp ring in the surface color around the dot, for a dot on an avatar.

options.name: decorative
options.description: Hides the dot from TalkBack when nearby text says the same.

options.name: statusLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the presence (monarch_presencedot_online and the others).

states.name: online
states.description: A dot in the success color.

states.name: away
states.description: A dot in the warning color; in the high-contrast themes a ring with its leading half filled.

states.name: busy
states.description: A dot in the danger color; in the high-contrast themes a square.

states.name: do not disturb
states.description: A dot in the danger color with a bar across it in every theme.

states.name: offline
states.description: A ring in the subtle text color on the surface color in every theme.

states.name: overlay
states.description: A 2dp ring in the surface color around the dot.

appearance: The solid status roles of the theme: success for online, warning for away, danger for busy and do not disturb, with the danger on-solid role for the bar. Offline is a ring in the subtle text role on the surface role. The same roles are used in light, dark and both high-contrast themes; the high-contrast themes add the half-filled and square forms.
platformNotes: The web gives each status its own shape only in forced-colors mode; Android does the same in the two Monarch high-contrast themes, the closest equivalent. The web positions an overlay dot itself; on Android place it in a Box with Modifier.align(Alignment.BottomEnd). The web's hover title has no counterpart on touch. The custom status is one string, as on iOS, where the web takes an emoji and a text. The parameter names follow Android (overlay, decorative) for the iOS isOverlay and isDecorative.
accessibility: The dot is one TalkBack element whose content description is its text, such as "Away · In a meeting".
Do not disturb has a bar and offline is a ring in every theme; in the high-contrast themes away is half-filled and busy is a square, so all five differ by form.
decorative removes the dot from the semantics tree when the presence is already in text beside it.
The dot grows with the font size setting.
The dot is not interactive and has no touch target.
edgeCases: A custom status of only white space is ignored; surrounding white space is trimmed.
In the standard themes online, away and busy differ by color only for sighted users; show the presence in text where it matters.
The half-filled away dot fills its leading half, so it mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
The overlay ring makes the dot 4dp wider than its size.

examples.setupTemplate:
fun status(web: String): MonarchPresenceStatus =
    when (web) {
        "away" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Away
        "busy" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Busy
        "dnd" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.DoNotDisturb
        "offline" -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Offline
        else -> MonarchPresenceStatus.Online
    }
